preconditions.description: The length of array A is between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in array A are integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < len(A) for x in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in array A are within the range [0, N-1].
All elements in array A are distinct.

postconditions.description: The returned value is the length of the longest set S and is between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: any(all(A[A[A[i]]] != A[i] for i in range(len(A))) for _ in range(len(A)))
postconditions.description: There exists at least one starting index i such that the sequence does not repeat immediately.
